title: Overwatch season 5 adds new hero, map and major changes

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Blizzard Entertainment released Overwatch Season 5, “A Grim Doctrine,” on October 7, opening the final chapter of the game’s Reign of Talon storyline with new gameplay content, seasonal events and major hero changes.
The update introduces Doctrine, a new Support hero with a violent history tied to Doomfist, after the latter breaks him out of Grímsvötn prison.
Doctrine’s kit includes an Eternal Scepter that heals allies and damages enemies at mid-to-long range, while bat-like drones boost the team’s healing and attack speed.
His Ultimate redistributes lifeforce across the battlefield, giving allies Overhealth while reducing enemy health.

Grímsvötn also joins the game as the first new Escort map in years. Set inside a Talon-controlled prison built into an Icelandic volcanic fissure, the map expands the season’s Reign of Talon storyline.

The Halloween event, Mystery Madness: Graveyard Games, began October 7 and runs through November 2 (AEDT). Players respawn with random powers after each death, while weekly votes determine whether Ashe, Moira or Winston is summoned next. The mode’s roster eventually expands to 20 heroes.

The season also features an Overwatch x Shadow Monarch crossover running through October 20 (AEDT), bringing anime-inspired skins based on the series to five heroes: Genji as Sung Jinwoo, Reaper as Igris, Anran as Cha Hae-In, Reinhardt as Iron, and Lifeweaver as Choi Jong-In.

One of the season’s biggest gameplay changes is Sombra’s move from the Damage role to Support. Blizzard described the change as one of its biggest alterations to an existing hero. Roadhog also received a rework that changes his Scrap Gun and adds a new Trash Compactor ability.

The update brings back Unvaulted Passes, allowing players to earn rewards from revised Battle Passes from Seasons 1 through 15. It also introduces two new Mythics: Dragon Shaoxia Wuyang and Lucio’s first Mythic Weapon, Treblemaker.

Halloween-themed Battle Pass skins arrive with the season, followed by the Tech Witches cosmetic collection from October. 10 to 26 (AEDT). Competitive Team Drives return in October. 30 to 31 (AEDT), leading into the Reign of Talon finale.
